run.change_description: fix(utils/body,validator): normalize Content-Type media type for case-insensitive matching

summary.intent: Make Content-Type media-type matching case-insensitive in parseBody() and validator() while leaving parameters such as the multipart boundary intact (issue #5060, PR title and body).
summary.issue_fit: Partial — mixed-case JSON, urlencoded and multipart are now matched and boundaries preserved, but parseBody now fails after c.req.formData() has cached the body, a case that worked before.
summary.coverage: Complete merge-base diff of 6 files reviewed with callers in src/request.ts and src/validator/validator.ts; reviewer ran body, buffer, validator and request test files once at the head (144 passed, 1 skipped) plus a scratch probe against head and base sources; the 'unreviewed uncommitted changes' clause does not apply (clean tree).

findings.title: Keep parseBody working after c.req.formData()
findings.trigger: A handler awaits `c.req.formData()` on a multipart request and then calls `c.req.parseBody()`.
findings.impact: `parseFormData` now reads `arrayBuffer()`, which for a formData-only cache re-serializes the FormData with a new boundary and then parses it with the original Content-Type boundary. It rejects with `TypeError: Failed to parse body as FormData.` (a 500) where the base returned the fields.
findings.change: In `parseFormData`, reuse the cached form data when the request is a HonoRequest, for example by calling `request.formData()`, and normalize the media type only when parsing raw bytes.

requirements.evidence: src/utils/body.ts:99 lowercases the media type before matching; src/validator/validator.ts:24-26 regexes gain /i

requirements.source: issue-5060/expected-behavior/"Parameter values such as multipart boundaries should remain intact"
requirements.evidence: src/utils/buffer.ts:113 lowercases only the text before the first ';'; buffer.test.ts mixed-case boundary test passes
body.test.ts, validator.test.ts and buffer.test.ts add mixed-case urlencoded, JSON and multipart cases; run once at head, all pass
Issue behavior implemented, but parseBody regresses after c.req.formData() (utils/body/parsebody-after-formdata)
